metadata.title: Health Coverage for {partner} Clients | Isaac Plans
metadata.description: Affordable health coverage with a licensed bilingual agent. A free consultation, a plan that fits your budget, and proof of coverage you can use right away.
metadata.imageAlt: Isaac Plans Insurance — affordable health coverage

partnerReferral.heroNote: Free consultation · No obligation · Se habla español

audience.label: Why this matters
audience.title: Coverage that meets the requirement — and that you can actually use

benefits.label: What you get
benefits.title: Real coverage, explained in plain language

items.title: Built around your budget
items.body: We start from what you can pay each month and work backwards to the best plan at that price.

items.title: Coverage that starts fast
items.body: No waiting for an open enrollment window. Coverage can begin in days, not months.

items.title: Proof of coverage in writing
items.body: You get documentation you can present wherever you are asked to show you have medical coverage.

items.title: Doctors, urgent care, and prescriptions
items.body: Benefits you will actually use — office visits, urgent care, labs, and help with prescription costs.

items.title: Everything in Spanish
items.body: From the first call to the day you use your card, you are never left guessing what something means.

items.title: A licensed agent, not a call center
items.body: The same person who enrolls you is the person you call when you have a question later.

steps.label: How it works
steps.title: Three steps, about a minute of your time

items.title: Send your information
items.body: Fill out the short form. It takes about a minute and there is no obligation.

items.title: We call you
items.body: A licensed agent calls you in English or Spanish, listens to your situation, and explains what fits.

items.title: You get covered
items.body: If you like the plan, you enroll the same day and receive your proof of coverage by email.

agent.label: Who you will talk to

agent.body: I have spent years helping Hispanic families find coverage they can afford and understand. When you call, you talk to me — not a script. If nothing fits your budget, I will tell you that honestly.

faq.label: Common questions
faq.title: The questions people ask us first

items.q: Do I need a Social Security number or a green card?
items.a: No. These plans do not require a Social Security number or permanent residency to apply. We will confirm what applies to your specific situation on the call.
It depends on your age, where you live, and how many people you are covering. Tell us your budget and we will show you what is possible at that number before you commit to anything.

No. This is a private alternative for people who do not qualify for a marketplace subsidy or who need coverage outside open enrollment. If you do qualify for the marketplace, we will tell you honestly — we handle that too.

items.q: What does it cost me to ask?
items.a: Nothing. The consultation is free and there is no obligation to enroll. If nothing fits your budget, we will say so.

items.q: Can I cover my spouse and children?
items.a: Yes. Family coverage is common and usually costs far less per person than covering everyone separately.

items.q: Does this affect my immigration case?
items.a: Buying private health coverage is a normal, lawful purchase. We are insurance agents, not attorneys, so for questions about your case itself, keep talking to {partner} — that is what they are there for.

closing.title: Ready to see what you qualify for?
closing.body: One short call, in your language, with no pressure and no cost.
